chapters.name: The overhauled chambers
chapters.text: Every block of chiseled copper inside trial chambers will activate something when scraped. All standard trial chambers contain seven chambers and a boss chamber. Completing a boss chamber will award you with either a trident on standard difficulty or a heavy core on ominous difficulty. Vaults are split between armor, valuables and weapons. Vaults give much better loot after drinking a luck potion!

items.name: Heavy Core
items.text: Completing a boss chamber will award you with either a trident on standard difficulty or a heavy core on ominous difficulty.

items.name: Daredevil
items.text: Sets off an explosion on the opponent if hit with a smash attack to deal massive damage, but also damages the user depending on how close they are.

items.name: Equity
items.text: Axes mimic Flame II and Knockback II (along with a small damage increase) when attacking an entity holding a sword.

items.name: Razor Tip
items.text: Spears deal 2x damage if a hit is landed right at the tip of the attacker's attack range.

items.name: Storm Front
items.text: Releases a wind charge explosion when thrown at anything. Acts as a renewable wind charge but with fall damage.
